items.headline: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Filed
items.text: LIV Golf officially filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy with up to $1 billion in liabilities, leaving stars like Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau's futures uncertain.

items.headline: Trump's Irish Open Visit Impact
items.text: With President Donald Trump visiting the Irish Open at Trump Doonbeg, Rory McIlroy says there will be tight security, limited crowds, and an altered atmosphere, but players plan to focus on their game.
